art_direction: 浅开心果底雾紫双眼，左低右高，目光微抬。
composition_variation: Aim both large black pupils just above the viewer while keeping them connected to the softly bowed upper lids. The left eye stays three percent lower and sixteen percent less open than the higher right bowl. Matching dusty lilac bands remain most visible underneath. Preserve a generous gap and rounded lower arcs, with one narrow long ivory glint inside each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
